name: Ready Spell, Greater (Metamagic)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Quicken Spell, Ready Spell

Benefit: This feat works exactly like Ready Spell does, save that you may cast the prepared spell as an immediate action instead of as a swift action. You may still only have one readied spell prepared at any time.

A Greater readied spell takes a spell slot 4 levels higher than the spell’s actual level.
